comparisons.reason: Different constructs and aggregation. Item 0 is an 'any' check for whether a comment asserts the OP's claim or a stated proposition is false or logically invalid, with a carve-out for systemic-harm quantification and quoted positions. Item 1 is an 'all' check for whether every rebutting comment uses abstract or theoretical reasoning and none contains a personal anecdote. Item 1 also differs on empty-list handling: it returns null, while item 0 returns 0.
